# Country TLDs that BlogScroll does not accept. A submission that uses one (site, favicon, feed,
# or the domain the home page redirects to) is closed by the submission check, and approval refuses it.
# Basis: the US Commerce "foreign adversaries" list (15 CFR 791.4), plus Belarus.
# Non-Latin TLDs are in punycode.
ru            # Russia
su            # Soviet Union, still used by Russian sites
xn--p1ai      # .рф Russia
ir            # Iran
xn--mgba3a4f16a  # .ایران Iran
kp            # North Korea
cu            # Cuba
cn            # China
xn--fiqs8s    # .中国 China
xn--fiqz9s    # .中國 China
hk            # Hong Kong
ve            # Venezuela
by            # Belarus
xn--90ais     # .бел Belarus
